entities.summary: First Gospel in the NT canon, written for a Jewish audience. Emphasizes Jesus as the fulfillment of OT prophecy and the new Moses. Contains the Sermon on the Mount (chs. 5–7), the Great Commission (28:18-20), and five major teaching discourses.
